title: Is there a connection between autism and intelligence?
metaTitle: Understanding Autism and Intelligence - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Explore more about the complex relationship between autism and intelligence, and how Pinnacle Blooms Network helps every child flourish using their unique strengths.
html: It's a complex tapestry when it comes to intelligence and autism. Individuals with autism span the full spectrum of intellectual abilities. Some may have intellectual disabilities whereas others may exhibit above-average intelligence. At Pinnacle Blooms, our goal is to help every child find their unique strengths and succeed.
